acceptance_criteria: Traces to its accepted system and software anchors and is verified by its named checks, harness route, or report inspection.
statement: No benchmark command shall open a TCP listener, create an AF_INET or AF_INET6 socket, use DNS, a resolver, or TLS, contact an external peer, execute a legacy binary or production workload, or claim runtime, compatibility, or production readiness beyond the measured evidence.
title: Public safety and forbidden resources
